name: jamaica-gct
description: Jamaica General Consumption Tax (GCT) for 2026, for registered taxpayers preparing or reviewing the monthly Form 4A standard return. Covers the 15% standard rate (from April 2020), 25% on telephone services and instruments, the 7% residential electricity line, the J$15,000,000 registration threshold from 1 April 2025, zero-rated exports, exempt supplies, imported services by reverse charge, input tax credit rules (50% on entertainment and motor vehicle costs, capital goods over 24 months, apportionment above 5% exempt supplies), tax invoices, the return due by the last day of the following month and the registration penalties. Trigger on Jamaica GCT, Jamaica VAT, Form 4A, GCT return, TAJ GCT, GCT registration threshold. Built from Tax Administration Jamaica pages; not reviewed by an accountant.
